# owner: platform
"""Find the stretches of opening hours that nobody covers."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from hourglass.parsing import format_clock
from hourglass.models import Span
from hourglass.merging import merge_spans
from hourglass.errors import ProjectError

# ---
def uncovered_gaps(worked: Iterable[Span], opening: Span) -> List[str]:
    """Labels such as "gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)", one per uncovered stretch.

    Raises ProjectError when a worked span reaches outside opening hours.
    """
    merged = merge_spans(worked)
    for span in merged:
        if span.start < opening.start or span.end > opening.end:
            raise ProjectError(f"span {span} is outside opening hours {opening}")

    labels = []
    cursor = opening.start
    for span in merged:
        if span.start > cursor:
            labels.append(_label(cursor, span.start))
        cursor = span.end
    if cursor < opening.end:
        labels.append(_label(cursor, opening.end))
    return labels

def _label(start: int, end: int) -> str:
    return f"gap {format_clock(start)}-{format_clock(end)} ({end - start} min)"
after.tests/test_gaps.py:
# owner: platform
import unittest

from hourglass.parsing import parse_span
from hourglass.gaps import uncovered_gaps
from hourglass.errors import ProjectError


def spans(*texts):
    return [parse_span(text) for text in texts]


class UncoveredGapTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_gap_in_the_middle(self):
        result = uncovered_gaps(spans("09:00-12:00", "13:00-17:00"), parse_span("09:00-17:00"))
        self.assertEqual(result, ["gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)"])

    def test_gaps_at_both_ends_and_overlaps_merged(self):
        result = uncovered_gaps(spans("10:00-12:00", "11:00-15:00"), parse_span("09:00-17:00"))
        self.assertEqual(result, ["gap 09:00-10:00 (60 min)", "gap 15:00-17:00 (120 min)"])

    def test_nobody_working_leaves_whole_day(self):
        result = uncovered_gaps([], parse_span("09:00-10:00"))
        self.assertEqual(result, ["gap 09:00-10:00 (60 min)"])

    def test_full_coverage_has_no_gaps(self):
        result = uncovered_gaps(spans("09:00-13:00", "13:00-17:00"), parse_span("09:00-17:00"))
        self.assertEqual(result, [])

    def test_span_outside_opening_hours_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            uncovered_gaps(spans("08:00-12:00"), parse_span("09:00-17:00"))
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            uncovered_gaps(spans("16:00-18:00"), parse_span("09:00-17:00"))
